'''Ziakas''' was a [[Derriphan (creature)|Derriphan]] who lived in [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon's]] [[Glow Dome]], feeding upon the life essence of [[Gender/Legends|females]] who were dazzled by the light shows in the Glow Dome. One of its hosts was the Glow Dome's co-owner, [[Kandria A'Daasha]].

==Biography==
Ziakas was a parasitic ball of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy that fed and absorbed the essence of its host. Earlier in its 'life' it had almost been destroyed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It somehow traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] where it became attached to [[Glow Dome]] co-owner [[Kandria A'Daasha]]. She had recently been infected so Ziakas' feedings and the blackouts from being controlled were attributed to fatigue and too much partying rather than something more sinister.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Highly intelligent despite being a ball of energy, Ziakas was more reserved and emotional than others of its kind. It was easily angered but also cautious and wary of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It preferred targeting [[Gender/Legends|females]] and [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] over men and aliens. It also preferred to keep a low profile, only hosting and feeding behind closed doors and using [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] to make its host forget that it was being secretly controlled.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Derriphan, Ziakas was powerful in the dark side, especially when it came to powers of control. It could also use the skills of its host by controlling their bodies and reading their memories however once it started absorbing those skills and draining those memories it could not utilize them anymore.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ziakas was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. It was illustrated by [[Tom O'Neill]].
